sources.title: 202 More Sound Effects
sources.author: OwlishMedia
sources.description: I recorded some more sounds around my home. Included: Camera sounds Cloth sounds Drinking water sounds Keys, locking and unlocking, opening doors Kitchen items and appliances Coins and money Paper, scissors, masking tape, stapler Phone Plastic crinkling Velcro Fidget spinner Nasal spray pump

sources.title: 100 CC0 SFX #2
sources.author: rubberduck
sources.description: another pack with 100 CC0 sfx Note: the preview does not contain all sounds, it also contains loopable sfx which are shorter in the preview. Included are: air flowing, door, various footstep, glass, hit, item, loops (ambient, machine, construction site, highway / street, flowing water), metal / metal hit, misc, stones, switch, thunder and wood / wood hit - sounds

sources.title: 40 CC0 water / splash / slime SFX
sources.author: rubberduck
sources.description: I created some water, splash and slime sounds: 3x bubble 6x loop sounds (bubbles, rain, water) 16x slime (partly recorded from real slime) 15x splash The loop sounds are also a bit longer as in the preview.
